title: Lev-3B: A Data Recipe for Compact Probabilistic Log Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.38915v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many log-analysis tasks involve choosing among known options, such as detecting anomalous sessions or identifying attack techniques, and benefit from calibrated probabilities. We present Lev-3B, an open 3B-parameter decision model built on Granite-4.1-3B-Base with a shared pointer readout, and study its training recipe. The recipe has two key parts. First, training follows a curriculum: the model learns bounded natural-language decisions, using no log data, before it sees any logs. Second, the log stage mixes the target tasks with general log data spanning 35 auxiliary tasks unrelated to either evaluation task. We evaluate one shared checkpoint on sources seen in training and on sources excluded from training, calibration and model selection. translated_title: Lev-3B：紧凑型概率日志决策模型的数据配方
translated_abstract: 许多日志分析任务涉及在已知选项中进行选择，例如检测异常会话或识别攻击技术，并且受益于经过校准的概率输出。我们提出了Lev-3B，这是一个基于Granite-4.1-3B-Base构建的开源30亿（3B）参数决策模型，采用共享指针读出机制，并对其训练配方进行了研究。该配方包含两个关键部分。首先，训练遵循课程学习方式：模型在接触任何日志数据之前，先学习基于自然语言的有界决策任务。其次，在日志训练阶段，将目标任务与涵盖35个与两个评估任务均无关的辅助任务的通用日志数据相混合。我们在训练中见过的数据源和训练中排除的数据源上评估了同一个共享检查点，并考察了校准能力和模型选择表现。两阶段训练配方比仅在日志数据上训练具有明显更好的迁移效果。添加通用日志数据显著提升了模型在未见过数据源上的性能。Lev-3B以传统模型一小部分的服务成本……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Lev-3B通过“先学有界自然语言决策、再用通用日志数据混合训练”的两阶段课程配方，构建了一个以极低服务成本实现优异跨数据源迁移能力的开源30亿参数概率日志决策模型。
en_tdlr: Lev-3B is an open 3B-parameter probabilistic log decision model whose two-stage curriculum—learning bounded natural-language decisions first, then mixing general log data from 35 auxiliary tasks—achieves strong cross-source transfer and calibration at a fraction of the serving cost of larger models.
